h: Significa: Te acostumbrarás al ruido después de unos días.
o: long
you'll
used
say: You'll get used to the noise after a few days.

p: ¿Qué significa «It will take time. When we moved here, my daughter would cry every night. Now she loves her classmates, and she has got used to everything.»?
o: Tercero, get used to significa familiarizarse, un proceso, y también va seguido de un sustantivo o de la forma ing.
¡Enhorabuena! Has terminado el tercer bloque del nivel B1. Este domingo tienes una prueba con todos los episodios de esta semana.
Llevará tiempo. Cuando nos mudamos aquí, mi hija lloraba cada noche. Ahora adora a sus compañeros y se ha acostumbrado a todo.
say: It will take time. When we moved here, my daughter would cry every night. Now she loves her classmates, and she has got used to everything.

p: Escucha y elige lo que oyes
o: Children adapt quickly. It is the parents who need more time to get used to the changes. I still miss our old neighborhood!
Congratulations! You have finished the third block of level B1. This Sunday, you have a test with all the episodes of this week.
Notice the big difference. After be used to, we use the ing form, not the infinitive. After used to, without be, we use the infinitive.
say: Children adapt quickly. It is the parents who need more time to get used to the changes. I still miss our old neighborhood!

alt.p: ¿Cómo se dice «Los niños se adaptan rápido. Son los padres los que necesitan más tiempo para acostumbrarse a los cambios. ¡Yo todavía echo de menos nuestro antiguo barrio!»?
o: Congratulations! You have finished the third block of level B1. This Sunday, you have a test with all the episodes of this week.

Notice the big difference. After be used to, we use the ing form, not the infinitive. After used to, without be, we use the infinitive.
alt.say: Children adapt quickly. It is the parents who need more time to get used to the changes. I still miss our old neighborhood!

p: Completa: Every Sunday we would _____ my grandparents in the village.
h: Significa: Cada domingo visitábamos a mis abuelos en el pueblo.
o: visit
noun
week
say: Every Sunday we would visit my grandparents in the village.

p: ¿Qué significa «She didn't use to like spicy food, but now she loves it.»?
o: A ella antes no le gustaba la comida picante, pero ahora le encanta.
Estoy acostumbrado a levantarme a las cinco, porque trabajo en el mercado.
Antes de los errores, una conversación más, sobre un colegio nuevo.
say: She didn't use to like spicy food, but now she loves it.

p: Escucha y elige lo que oyes
o: Did you use to have a dog when you were a child?
I used to smoke, but I gave it up five years ago.
We're not used to living in such a small apartment.
say: Did you use to have a dog when you were a child?

p: Completa: Don't be shy. Speaking out loud is the best way to _____ your pronunciation.
h: Significa: No te dé vergüenza. Hablar en voz alta es la mejor forma de mejorar tu pronunciación.
o: improve
smoke
we're
say: Don't be shy. Speaking out loud is the best way to improve your pronunciation.

p: ¿Qué significa «She used to be shy, but now she speaks in public easily.»?
o: No estamos acostumbrados a vivir en un piso tan pequeño.
Me llevó mucho tiempo acostumbrarme al nuevo programa.
Antes era tímida, pero ahora habla en público con facilidad.
say: She used to be shy, but now she speaks in public easily.
